meta_description: The Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi 2027: June 7 at Kung Wiman Beach. 21.1K from Scenic Marathon Series at Thailand's eastern-seaboard coastal gem.
dek: Set for 7 June 2027 at Kung Wiman Beach in Chanthaburi — Thailand's fruit-basket province — this Scenic Marathon Series event offers a single 21.1K distance. Registration pending.
verdict: The Scenic Half Marathon Chanthaburi brings the Scenic Marathon Series to one of Thailand's most underrated coastal destinations — Kung Wiman Beach in Chanthaburi, a province known for its gemstone market, its fruit orchards, and a coastline that rivals Krabi without the crowds. A single-distance 21.1K format keeps it focused. June is the early wet season on Thailand's eastern seaboard. Registration isn't open yet. For runners wanting a Scenic Series half marathon in a destination that most tourists overlook, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: Chanthaburi: Thailand's Hidden Coast
paragraphs: Chanthaburi is one of Thailand's most underrated provinces — known for its gemstone market, fruit orchards, and a coastline that's largely undiscovered by international tourism. [1] Kung Wiman Beach provides a scenic, uncrowded coastal road for the half marathon. Scenic Marathon Series handles production.
